77	    """Test that time-weighted average excludes the early partial period when
78	    series have misaligned start times.
79	
80	    When merging multiple timeseries (e.g., from different replicas), series
81	    that start late are implicitly 0 before their first data point. This
82	    undercounts the total and biases the mean downward. The fix excludes
83	    the partial period by starting the averaging window when all series
84	    have contributed at least one point.
85	    """
86	    # Two replicas with misaligned starts: r1 starts at 0.2, r2 starts at 0.1
87	    # From 0.1 to 0.2, only r2 contributes (total=3); from 0.2 onward both (total=8)
88	    base_time = 1000.0  # Use epoch-like timestamps
89	    series1 = [
90	        TimeStampedValue(base_time + 0.2, 5.0),
91	        TimeStampedValue(base_time + 0.8, 7.0),
92	        TimeStampedValue(base_time + 1.5, 6.0),
93	    ]
94	    series2 = [
95	        TimeStampedValue(base_time + 0.1, 3.0),
96	        TimeStampedValue(base_time + 0.9, 4.0),
97	        TimeStampedValue(base_time + 1.4, 8.0),
98	    ]
99	
100	    merged = merge_instantaneous_total([series1, series2])
101	    # Merged: (0.1, 3), (0.2, 8), (0.8, 10), (0.9, 11), (1.4, 15), (1.5, 14)
102	    last_window_s = 0.5  # Extend window to base_time + 2.0
103	
104	    # Without aligned window: includes partial period [0.1, 0.2) where total=3
105	    avg_without_aligned = time_weighted_average(
106	        merged,
107	        window_start=None,
108	        window_end=None,
109	        last_window_s=last_window_s,
110	    )
111	
112	    # With aligned window (start at 0.2 when all series have reported): excludes partial
113	    aligned_start = base_time + 0.2
114	    avg_with_aligned = time_weighted_average(
115	        merged,
116	        window_start=aligned_start,
117	        window_end=None,
118	        last_window_s=last_window_s,
119	    )
120	
121	    # The aligned average should be higher because we excluded the period
122	    # [0.1, 0.2) where the total was underestimated (3 instead of 8)
123	    assert avg_with_aligned > avg_without_aligned, (
124	        f"Aligned avg ({avg_with_aligned}) should exceed unaligned ({avg_without_aligned}) "
125	        "since we exclude the partial period with underestimated total"
126	    )
127	
128	    # Verify aggregate_timeseries with window_start produces the aligned result
129	    result = aggregate_timeseries(
130	        merged,
131	        AggregationFunction.MEAN,
132	        last_window_s=last_window_s,
133	        window_start=aligned_start,
134	    )
135	    assert result == avg_with_aligned
